summary.short_summary: Banyan expressed initial interest in a proposal but hesitated to provide a Letter of Intent (LOI) due to concerns about client retention linked to a recent cancellation in Iceland. The company has maintained consistent revenues of around £5.5 million over the past four years, bolstered by new deals, and has recently secured £460,000 in tech-based licensed income, indicating strong growth and pipeline stability.
